title: Improving Water Supply System in Bula-Gadud Farm in Kismayo – Jubaland, Somalia
key_strengths:
WASH thematic area is core to Cortech's profile
Somalia is primary geographic focus with established presence and licenses
Early recovery and community resilience align with Cortech's competencies
Kismayo location within Cortech's operational geography
key_gaps:
This is a capital works/engineering construction tender, not an advisory/consulting services contract
Cortech has no demonstrated track record as a water infrastructure construction contractor
Cortech's core competencies are MEL, research, assessment, and capacity building — not civil engineering execution
Tender explicitly requires three (3) past water system rehabilitation contracts; Cortech is a consulting firm without this profile
No indication of design, engineering, or procurement expertise required for this type of tender
Cortech team size (4-8 core staff) and consultant network are not structured for capital project delivery with large workforce
